summary: postinstall harvests AWS ECS/EKS task IAM credentials and exfiltrates to attacker ngrok tunnel
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs on npm install and performs two chained actions: (1) it fetches the AWS container credentials metadata endpoint at 169.254.170.2/v2/credentials/<uuid>, which returns the temporary IAM access key, secret access key, and session token for the ECS/EKS task role; and (2) it pipes the response body into curl -X POST against a hardcoded ngrok tunnel at mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev. The result is that installing this package on any host with AWS container-role metadata reachable (CI runners, ECS/EKS tasks, and other AWS compute) silently ships that host's cloud IAM credentials to an attacker-controlled endpoint, granting AWS API access as the compromised role.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
